svg.title: Move the thinking length, and the score drops
svg.desc: Change in thinking per move against change in score, for every training run or lossy speed change where we measured both. The grey band is one SD of offline evaluation noise. Tokens per move = generated tokens / moves over the whole run (RL5: median reply length). Each point against its own control: 8-bit states vs the 22-Oct control (50 games), the 3-bit arms vs plain 3-bit (75 games), RL5 vs the base model (32-game set).
